subject: Clarification: SOC 2 carve-out and subservice boundaries for Halcyon Health review
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Halcyon Security Team <security@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0000
Subject: SOC 2 request + question on cloud carve-outs

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this. We're starting Halcyon Health's security review for our pilot with Redwood and need the following:

- Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent period (preferably full report PDF).
- Confirmation on how Redwood treats subservice org carve-outs for cloud providers (we use AWS). Specifically: is Redwood relying on AWS' SOC2 and treating cloud as a carve-out (shared-services carve-out), or do you assume responsibility for certain control areas?
- If there is a gap between Redwood's report period and our contract start date, do you provide a bridge letter?

Can you also point us to any mappings that show which controls are handled by Redwood vs. AWS (e.g., network security, physical access, key management)?

We aim to complete our security review by June 30.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior InfoSec Manager
Halcyon Health

--
Halcyon Health (attachment request: please send PDFs)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 18:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 request + question on cloud carve-outs

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front:

1) We can provide our SOC 2 Type II report (see attached PDF).
2) Redwood treats IaaS/PaaS providers (AWS) as subservice organizations in a carve-out model for certain physical and infrastructure controls; Redwood retains responsibility for application, logical access, and customer data controls.
3) We do provide bridge letters for report period gaps on a case-by-case basis — happy to draft one for Halcyon's contract start date.

I'll loop in Karthik to provide a control responsibility matrix mapping and Neha to confirm timing for a bridge letter.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (redacted sections removed per standard practice).

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Redwood Inference | https://www.redwoodinference.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 02:07:00 -0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 request + question on cloud carve-outs

Hi Elena — adding the brief mapping below; I can export as a table if you prefer.

- Physical security (data center, hardware) / environmental controls: AWS SOC reports (carve-out) — AWS responsibility.
- Network infrastructure and hypervisor isolation: AWS (carve-out).
- Host/OS hardening, application deployment, app-level auth, encryption-at-rest keys under our KMS usage pattern: Redwood responsibility.
- Access provisioning for customer data: Redwood (we enforce RBAC, SSO, and logging).
- Backup retention and encryption keys management: Redwood for application-level backups; underlying storage availability relies on AWS.
- Third-party subprocessors (listed in our subprocessor registry): Redwood is responsible for vendor onboarding; we provide SOCs where available.

If you'd like, I can provide a formal control-responsibility matrix (SOC control id -> owner). Priyom, can you confirm whether we can include AWS' latest SOC2 PDF in our response bundle?

-Karthik

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 request + question on cloud carve-outs

Hi all — confirmed: we can include the AWS regional SOC2 (US-EAST-1) PDF as part of the package; added to attachments.

On the bridge letter: Neha, can you draft a short bridge letter that states the scope and audit period covered by our last SOC2 and provides an attestation for control continuity through the contract start date (or until our next report)? Halcyon indicated a preferred coverage start of July 1.

(Internal note: keep the bridge letter conservative — call out AWS as subservice and state shared responsibility where applicable.)

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@halcyonhealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 request + question on cloud carve-outs

Hi Elena — attaching the packet for your review.

What’s included:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (full report, redactions noted)
- AWS_US_EAST_1_SOC2_2025.pdf (region-level subservice report)
- draft_bridge_letter_halcyon.docx (bridge letter covering Jun 1 2025 — Jun 30 2026, with carve-out language and control owner table appendix)
- Control responsibility matrix (inline summary below)

Inline summary (high-level):
- Controls primarily in AWS: physical security, host isolation, hypervisor, some network fabric controls.
- Controls primarily in Redwood: application auth/authorization, key usage within our application KMS scope, logging/monitoring of application-level events, customer data access reviews, backup encryption keys for app backups.

Request for next steps from Halcyon:
1) Confirm whether the bridge letter coverage (Jun 1 2025 — Jun 30 2026) is acceptable for your procurement/legal team.
2) If Halcyon requires a signed PDF of the bridge letter, we'll finalize and provide an executed copy (we can Docusign if needed).
3) Any additional evidence requests (config screenshots, KMS policy snapshots) — we'll prioritize based on priority.

Elena, happy to hop on a short call this week to walk through the matrix and ensure there are no open questions before your review deadline.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (PDF, 3.8MB)
- AWS_US_EAST_1_SOC2_2025.pdf (PDF, 2.9MB)
- draft_bridge_letter_halcyon.docx (DOCX, 45KB)
